Key difference: Mark XX has a date window and "IWC" logo; Mark XVIII also. The Mark XX has slightly thinner bezel and the case is 40mm. Both look similar. The Mark XVIII's hands are different? The Mark XX has different hour hand... Actually both have the classic pilot hands.

The photo: the hands look like IWC pilot hands (sword-shaped hands with... actually the hour hand is a "sword" shape, minute hand is... In the photo the hands look like baton/sword hands rather than the classic "syringe" style of IWC pilot watches. Hmm, the hour hand appears to be a leaf/syringe shape and minute hand a straight baton. That's the Mark XVIII style.

Actually wait — the hands in the photo look like a "Mercedes"... no. Let me look: minute hand pointing at 10 (near 11), hour hand pointing down at 6? There's a long thin seconds hand. The hour hand appears to be a sword shape with slight widening.

The Mark XVIII IW327001 is on leather strap, steel, 40mm, automatic 35111. Confidence moderate.

Alternatively, Mark XX IW328201 is on leather with black dial — 40mm, automatic 32111. The Mark XX has a date only (no day), and the date window is rectangular. The Mark XVIII has date window too.

Difference: Mark XX's case is slightly thinner and has a different... Also Mark XX has "IWC" in a different font? Hmm.

Look at the dial: the numeral "9" at 9 o'clock. In the Mark XX, the numerals... Both are similar.

One distinguishing thing: Mark XVIII has the date window at 3 with white date on black background? Mark XVIII IW327001 date wheel is white with black numbers... Mark XX IW328201 has black date window with white numbers? Actually the Mark XX has a date wheel matching the dial (black with white numerals)? Hmm.

In the photo the date appears as white numerals on black background? The date window looks white with dark numbers at ~19-20? Hard to tell. It says "19" or similar in a white window.

Hmm. The Mark XVIII date is a white disc with black numerals. In the photo, the date appears... the window looks lighter than the dial with a dark number. That matches Mark XVIII.

Actually, looking at the image, the date window appears white/light with dark digits. So IW327001 (Mark XVIII, black dial, black leather strap, steel).

Wait, but IW327001 — let me confirm. IWC Pilot's Watch Mark XVIII reference IW327001: stainless steel, black dial, black calfskin strap. Yes. IW327002 is on steel bracelet. IW327004? Actually IW327001 = leather strap; IW327002 = steel bracelet. Hmm, some sources: IW327001 (black dial, leather), IW327002 (black dial, steel bracelet), IW327003 (?), IW327004 = "Le Petit Prince" blue dial with brown leather? Actually IW327004 is the Le Petit Prince edition with blue dial.

So I'll give IW327001.

Hmm, but could it be Mark XX (IW328201 black dial leather)? Mark XX dial: the date window is at 3, and the dial has... The Mark XX's hands are the same. One difference: Mark XX has a flat sapphire with... no.

Another difference: the Mark XVIII has "AUTOMATIC" and "SCHAFFHAUSEN" text - in the photo it says "AUTOMATIC / SCHAFFHAUSEN" above "IWC" at 3 o'clock. Both models have this. Hmm, Mark XX says "IWC SCHAFFHAUSEN" plus "AUTOMATIC".

Note the photo shows the seconds hand straight with a long tail. Both.

I'll go with IW327001, confidence ~0.5.

Hmm, actually one more distinguishing: the Mark XVIII case is 40mm with a "soft-iron inner case" and the crown. The Mark XX also.

Also, the Mark XX's minute hand... Actually a notable difference: Mark XX's hour hand has a broader "syringe"? No.

Let me just settle: IWC Pilot's Watch Mark XVIII, IW327001.

Hmm, but consider the possibility of Mark XX where the dial has numerals in a slightly lighter weight, plus the Mark XX has "IWC" logo with the date at 3. Honestly, the difference: The Mark XVIII's dial has the 6 and 9 numerals. Mark XX too.

Wait — in the photo, is there a numeral at 9? Yes, the 9 appears (rotated). And a triangle at 12. Some Mark XVIII dials have the 6 and 9 numerals while on the Mark XX... both.

I'll answer IW327001 with confidence 0.45.

Movement: automatic. Case: stainless-steel. Bracelet: leather.

Model family: "Pilot's Watch Mark XVIII". Brand IWC.
